question: Report the format only and quote nothing longer than 4 words. 1) Presenter face: is a real person on camera as the presenter at any point (yes or no)? 2) On screen: which of these, with rough share of the runtime: drawn or 3D animation, AI-generated images or AI video, text cards or a text post, gameplay or unrelated satisfying footage, stock footage, real phone or security footage of the actual event, news broadcast footage. 3) Audio: human voiceover, synthetic voiceover, on-camera speech, or music only. 4) How the story is framed: a real reported event with a named source, an anonymous first-person story, or fiction or labeled as AI-made. 5) Does the video need real footage of the actual event to work (yes or no, one line why)? 6) Length in seconds and the structure as 4 beats of 10 words or fewer each, paraphrased, with the timestamp where the payoff lands. 7) The opening move in one line: the kind of first line or picture, not its words.
